describes: Loomground Topos grammar-level nD system: where a source sits in the structure of legal authority. Grammar-level only; grounded instances (ladders, organs, competences of real legal orders) are policy data loaded from a caller-supplied local path. Jurisdiction is source-level and belongs to the core versum system, not to this plane.

vocabulary.open: SPEC.md 7.3: the rank ladder is per-system policy data; the grammar's rank-value is any number or null, so no closed vocabulary is published
SPEC.md 7.2: the territorial level ladder is per-system policy data; the grammar admits any id
SPEC.md 2 and 9: a jurisdiction supplies its organs; the grammar admits any id
SPEC.md 7.4: competence domains and their allocation vocabulary are per-system policy data
the grammar publishes no scope vocabulary; subject-matter scope is per-system policy data like competence (SPEC.md 7.4)
the grammar publishes no reception vocabulary; reception mode is per-system policy data
